# awrun

> A priority-aware queue and dispatcher for agentic runs and ad-hoc CI builds. It also judges whether the runner pool is big enough for the queue it is draining, and can ask a host to grow it -- reserving capacity is zero-sum, so a saturated pool needs more of it, not a different share of it.

A shared runner pool serves whoever asked first, so an urgent one-line fix waits behind a queue of speculative work — and the only lever anyone has is asking people to stop pushing.

## Install

```
pip install awrun
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Queue two runs at different priorities and watch the urgent one overtake.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awrelay](https://aitherium.github.io/awrelay/) — Portable agent messaging — findings, alerts, coordination.
- [awevolve](https://aitherium.github.io/awevolve/) — Point an agent at a file and a command that scores it, and let it improve.
- [awrise](https://aitherium.github.io/awrise/) — Wake an agent on a schedule, let it do one thing, and put it back to sleep.
- [awpool](https://aitherium.github.io/awpool/) — The free half of the elastic work pool: dispatches public-safe work onto the free GitHub-hosted runners of the public aw* mirrors, so their idle CI minutes become compute. awrun remains the paid/self-hosted lane; this is its free twin.
- [awflow](https://aitherium.github.io/awflow/) — A deterministic workflow runtime — chain agent calls with journal replay and budget control.
- [awiam](https://aitherium.github.io/awiam/) — Who is this caller? A directory and session store that fails honestly.
- [awbac](https://aitherium.github.io/awbac/) — Role-based access control that fails closed and explains itself.
- [awdit](https://aitherium.github.io/awdit/) — An append-only audit trail whose gaps are DETECTABLE.
- [awseal](https://aitherium.github.io/awseal/) — Sign an artifact so a stranger can verify it.
- [awshare](https://aitherium.github.io/awshare/) — Publish an artifact and fetch it back verified.
